resources.string: Everybody builds one bridge together, from their own lane, all at the same time. You win together or you try again together.
A cart slides back and forth along your lane. Tap when it is inside the green spot (marked with a frame and a diamond) to place a plank.
The nearer the middle you tap, the sturdier the plank. Sturdy planks push the water back and make the final crossing quicker. A miss only makes your cart rest a moment.
Nobody can build more than two planks ahead of the slowest lane. When the rope between lanes is tight, wait for your friends.

Finish every lane before the water covers the bridge, then everybody crosses. Helper robots can fill empty lanes. Relaxed building and a bigger green spot for one builder help mixed ages play together. Same screen only: there is no Nearby or Online mode.
Some of the oldest bridges still in use are stone arch bridges built by the Romans, and a few are almost two thousand years old.
